# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `switchbot-inc` MCP server pointing at SwitchBot's hosted AI MindClip endpoint (`https://mindclip-mcp.switchbot.net/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE (S256), scope `mcp:mindclip:read` — no API key to configure.
- Logo: SwitchBot wordmark from the `OpenWonderLabs` GitHub organization.
